label: Mabisi
note: Zambian mabisi is made in a calabash or clay pot, and in recent years often a plastic container, since calabashes are scarce; a field trial found no difference between the vessels

about.text: A spontaneously fermented raw milk of Zambia, left at room temperature in a calabash for about two days. Lactococcus dominates, and seven named types are known, e.g. tonga and barotse.
